docker_compose_file:
name: dstack
services:
  attest-proxy:
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    depends_on:
      inference-auth-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      native-manifest-check:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    environment:
      ACME_DOMAINS: api.adverserial.ai
      ACME_EMAIL: ops@adverserial.ai
      ATTESTED_MODELS: adverserial/cyberseek
      AUTH_REQUIRED: '0'
      CERT_DIR: /state/certificates
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      CLOUDFLARE_ZONE: adverserial.ai
      COMPOSE_DIGEST: sha256:96ba75d8d59d93069da02661e2e6078f82b4cd7d2745a5b8b528057809831da4
      CONFIDENTIAL_ACTIVATION: active
      CONFIDENTIAL_MODE: '1'
      CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: https://chat.adverserial.ai
      DNS_PROVIDER: cloudflare
      DSTACK_SOCKET: /var/run/dstack.sock
      ENCLAVE_KEY_DIR: /state/keys
      EHBP_REQUIRED: '1'
      ENDPOINT: https://api.adverserial.ai
      ENTITLEMENT_AUDIENCE: https://api.adverserial.ai
      ENTITLEMENT_ISSUER: https://billing.adverserial.ai
      ENTITLEMENT_JWKS_JSON: '{"keys":[{"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","kid":"9ILSxW_NUHtA9Vfrzoq2yPS76EDd6ZbugqIcBcVQmCI","x":"zatmlekaVvhKB43-yNemBcngZNtjeCPewpmJmwFSoBQ","alg":"EdDSA","use":"sig"}]}'
      ENTITLEMENT_REPLAY_DIR: /state/used-entitlements
      GPU_EVIDENCE_FILE: /evidence/gpu-evidence.json
      INFERENCE_STATUS_FILE: /run/inference-status/status.json
      LISTEN_ADDR: :8443
      METER_AUDIENCE: https://billing.adverserial.ai
      METER_DELIVERY_MODE: direct-signed
      METER_INGRESS_SHARED_SECRET: ${METER_INGRESS_SHARED_SECRET}
      METER_ISSUER: https://api.adverserial.ai
      METER_OUTBOX_DIR: /state/meter-outbox
      METER_URL: https://billing.adverserial.ai
      MODEL_ID: adverserial/cyberseek
      MODEL_MANIFEST_FILE: /model-evidence/native-manifest.json
      POLICY_ID: adverserial-policy/cyberseek
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: https://api.adverserial.ai
      RECEIPT_AUDIENCE: https://chat.adverserial.ai
      RECEIPT_ISSUER: https://verify.adverserial.ai
      RUNTIME_DIGEST: sha256:b4f09a2ccbcfcc262d49600c3cd7f8581a793ea7d104947257b6a95500953b90
      UPSTREAM: http://sglang:30000
      UPSTREAM_BEARER_TOKEN_FILE: /run/handoff/upstream-token
      VERIFICATION_URL: https://verify.adverserial.ai
    image: ghcr.io/adverserialai/attest-proxy@sha256:5a41bcfb6d7f4f3d3df53ad5ac39a45d1d32a6db206e35c0380b81d56404824b
    networks:
      default: null
      inference: null
    ports:
    - mode: ingress
      target: 8443
      published: '443'
      protocol: tcp
    read_only: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m
    user: 65532:65532
    volumes:
    - type: bind
      source: /var/run/dstack.sock
      target: /var/run/dstack.sock
      read_only: true
      bind: {}
    - type: volume
      source: proxy-state-v2
      target: /state
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: gpu-evidence-state
      target: /evidence
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: model-evidence-state
      target: /model-evidence
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: inference-handoff
      target: /run/handoff
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: inference-status
      target: /run/inference-status
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
  gpu-evidence-collector:
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - capabilities:
                - gpu
              driver: nvidia
              count: 8
    environment:
      GPU_EVIDENCE_EXPECTED_TYPE: nvidia-cc
      GPU_EVIDENCE_INTERVAL: "300"
      GPU_EVIDENCE_MIN_GPU_COUNT: "8"
      GPU_EVIDENCE_OUT: /evidence/gpu-evidence.json
      NV_ATTESTATION_SERVICE_KEY: ${NV_ATTESTATION_SERVICE_KEY}
    image: ghcr.io/adverserialai/gpu-evidence-collector@sha256:88484069fde3c53f054b7d02645ab075166a24c0a43c2006723f148941967f06
    networks:
      default: null
    read_only: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m
    user: 65532:65532
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: gpu-evidence-state
        target: /evidence
        volume: {}
    working_dir: /tmp
  model-download:
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/bash
    - -c
    command:
    - "set -euo pipefail; marker=\"/data/.download-complete-$${MODEL_REVISION}\"; oldmarker=\"/data/model/.download-complete-$${MODEL_REVISION}\"; if [ -f \"$$marker\" ]; then echo download-already-complete; elif [ -f \"$$oldmarker\" ] && [ -f /data/model/model.safetensors.index.json ]; then rm -f \"$$oldmarker\"; rm -rf /data/model/.cache; touch \"$$marker\"; echo download-migrated-complete; else rm -rf /data/model; python3 -m pip install --quiet --no-cache-dir \"huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]\"; hf download \"$${MODEL_REPO}\" --revision \"$${MODEL_REVISION}\" --repo-type model --local-dir /data/model; rm -rf /data/model/.cache; rm -f \"$$oldmarker\"; touch \"$$marker\"; fi; test -f /data/model/model.safetensors.index.json"
    environment:
      HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER: '1'
      HF_TOKEN: ${HF_TOKEN}
      MODEL_REPO: Adverserial/cyberseek-v41-native
      MODEL_REVISION: 306ccc48a95e24f802774de950b57f5edd0c8487
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:91ee972ab751fb7180bc71c175865e36b091686600dca783d52b2511399810b3
    networks:
      default: null
    restart: 'no'
    user: 0:0
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cyberseek-v41-native-data
      target: /data
      volume: {}
  model-measurer:
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    environment:
      MODEL_ID: adverserial/cyberseek
      MODEL_MANIFEST_FILE: /model-evidence/native-manifest.json
      MODEL_ROOT: /native/model
    image: ghcr.io/adverserialai/model-measurer@sha256:5f5f0653a7f75a1414a68a0e063ba7fb628f225cfb81e3a21512c206c7f4ad82
    network_mode: none
    depends_on:
      model-perms:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    read_only: true
    restart: 'no'
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    user: 65532:65532
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cyberseek-v41-native-data
      target: /native
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: model-evidence-state
      target: /model-evidence
      volume: {}
  model-perms:
    depends_on:
      model-download:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - 'chmod -R a+rX /model && echo model-perms: ok'
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:91ee972ab751fb7180bc71c175865e36b091686600dca783d52b2511399810b3
    network_mode: none
    read_only: true
    restart: 'no'
    user: 0:0
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cyberseek-v41-native-data
      target: /model
      volume: {}
  sglang:
    image: lmsysorg/sglang@sha256:b4f09a2ccbcfcc262d49600c3cd7f8581a793ea7d104947257b6a95500953b90
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/bash
    - -c
    command:
    - |
      set -u
      BASE=/run/sglang-cache
      TOKEN_FILE=/run/handoff/upstream-token
      STATUS_FILE=/run/inference-status/status.json
      BOOTED="$$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
      KEY="$$(head -c 200 "$$TOKEN_FILE" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n')"
      case "$$KEY" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) KEY="" ;; esac
      if [ "$${#KEY}" -lt 32 ]; then echo "FATAL: no usable upstream token in $$TOKEN_FILE" >&2; sleep 30; exit 1; fi
      set -- "$$@" --api-key "$$KEY"
      status() {
        printf '{"ladder_id":"%s","rung":"%s","phase":"%s","attempt":"%s","started_at":"%s","updated_at":"%s","detail":"%s"}\n' "$${LID:-}" "$${RUNG:-}" "$$1" "$${NAME:-}" "$$BOOTED" "$$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$2" > "$$STATUS_FILE.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv -f "$$STATUS_FILE.tmp" "$$STATUS_FILE" 2>/dev/null
      }
      status preflight "container started"
      for d in tmp home hf cache torchinductor triton deepgemm flashinfer nv; do mkdir -p "$$BASE/$$d" || exit 1; done
      chown -R 65532:65532 "$$BASE" 2>/dev/null
      chmod -R a+rwX "$$BASE" 2>/dev/null
      chmod 1777 "$$BASE/tmp" 2>/dev/null
      export TMPDIR="$$BASE/tmp" HOME="$$BASE/home" HF_HOME="$$BASE/hf" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$$BASE/cache" TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR="$$BASE/torchinductor" TRITON_CACHE_DIR="$$BASE/triton" DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR="$$BASE/deepgemm" FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_DIR="$$BASE/flashinfer" CUDA_CACHE_PATH="$$BASE/nv/ComputeCache"
      shm_kb() { df -Pk /dev/shm 2>/dev/null | awk -v c="$$1" 'NR==2{print $$c}'; }
      echo "shm check: size_kb=$$(shm_kb 2) used_kb=$$(shm_kb 3)"
      echo "gpu preflight: nvidia-smi sees $$(nvidia-smi -L 2>/dev/null | grep -c GPU) GPUs"
      python3 -c 'import torch; print("gpu preflight: torch cuda available", torch.cuda.is_available(), "count", torch.cuda.device_count(), "nccl", torch.cuda.nccl.version())' 2>&1 | tail -1
      python3 -c 'import sglang; print("sglang version:", sglang.__version__)' 2>&1 | tail -1
      (
        while true; do
          echo "HEARTBEAT $$(date -u +%H:%M:%S) gpu_util%,mem_MiB: $$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ';') loadavg: $$(cut -d' ' -f1-3 /proc/loadavg 2>/dev/null) shm_used_kb: $$(shm_kb 3)"
          sleep 60
        done
      ) &
      HEARTBEAT_PID=$$!
      LID="$${LADDER_ID:-a}"
      STATE="$$BASE/.ladder-$$LID-rung"
      WINNER="$$BASE/.ladder-$$LID-winner"
      LADDER_LOG="$$BASE/.ladder-$$LID-log"
      BUDGET="$${LADDER_BUDGET_S:-2700}"
      PROBE="$${LADDER_PROBE_S:-30}"
      LAST=4
      HAVE_WINNER=1
      RUNG="$$(cat "$$WINNER" 2>/dev/null)"
      if [ -z "$$RUNG" ]; then HAVE_WINNER=0; RUNG="$$(cat "$$STATE" 2>/dev/null)"; fi
      case "$$RUNG" in 1|2|3|4) ;; *) RUNG=1 ;; esac
      echo "ladder $$LID history so far:"
      cat "$$LADDER_LOG" 2>/dev/null
      PORT=30000; prev=""
      for a in "$$@"; do
        case "$$prev" in --port) PORT="$$a" ;; --api-key) KEY="$$a" ;; esac
        prev="$$a"
      done
      ARGS=("$$@")
      DROP=0
      export NCCL_DEBUG="$${NCCL_DEBUG:-WARN}"
      case "$$RUNG" in
        1) NAME=recipe-unprivileged-user
           DROP=1
           ARGS+=(--admin-api-key "$$(python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))')") ;;
        2) NAME=recipe-root-user ;;
        3) NAME=no-speculation
           ARGS=(); skip=0
           for a in "$$@"; do
             if [ "$$skip" = 1 ]; then skip=0; continue; fi
             case "$$a" in --speculative-algorithm|--speculative-dspark-block-size) skip=1; continue ;; esac
             ARGS+=("$$a")
           done ;;
        4) NAME=sockets-fallback
           export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1 NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo NCCL_CUMEM_HOST_ENABLE=0
           ARGS+=(--disable-custom-all-reduce) ;;
      esac
      echo "ladder $$LID: starting rung $$RUNG ($$NAME), winner_known=$$HAVE_WINNER, budget=$${BUDGET}s"
      status loading "elapsed=0s winner_known=$$HAVE_WINNER"
      ready() {
        SGL_PROBE_KEY="$$KEY" python3 -c 'import os,sys,urllib.request
      r=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:%s/v1/models"%sys.argv[1],headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["SGL_PROBE_KEY"]})
      sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=10).status==200 else 1)' "$$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
      }
      START=$$(date +%s)
      STOPPING=0
      if [ "$$DROP" = 1 ] && command -v setpriv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        setpriv --reuid=65532 --regid=65532 --clear-groups python3 -m sglang.launch_server "$${ARGS[@]}" &
      else
        if [ "$$DROP" = 1 ]; then echo "WARN: setpriv unavailable; running without uid drop" >&2; fi
        python3 -m sglang.launch_server "$${ARGS[@]}" &
      fi
      CHILD=$$!
      (
        while kill -0 "$$CHILD" 2>/dev/null; do
          sleep "$$PROBE"
          NOW=$$(( $$(date +%s) - START ))
          if ready; then
            echo "$$(date -u +%FT%TZ) rung $$RUNG $$NAME READY after $${NOW}s" | tee -a "$$LADDER_LOG"
            echo "$$RUNG" > "$$WINNER"
            status ready "ready after $${NOW}s"
            exit 0
          fi
          status loading "elapsed=$${NOW}s gpu_mem_MiB=$$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ',')"
          if [ "$$HAVE_WINNER" = 0 ] && [ "$$RUNG" -lt "$$LAST" ] && [ "$$NOW" -ge "$$BUDGET" ]; then
            echo "$$(date -u +%FT%TZ) rung $$RUNG $$NAME not ready after $${NOW}s; moving on" | tee -a "$$LADDER_LOG"
            echo $$((RUNG+1)) > "$$STATE"
            status moving-on "rung $$RUNG not ready after $${NOW}s"
            kill -TERM "$$CHILD" 2>/dev/null
            exit 0
          fi
        done
      ) &
      MONITOR_PID=$$!
      trap 'STOPPING=1; kill -TERM "$$CHILD" 2>/dev/null' TERM INT
      wait "$$CHILD"; RC=$$?
      while kill -0 "$$CHILD" 2>/dev/null; do wait "$$CHILD"; RC=$$?; done
      ELAPSED=$$(( $$(date +%s) - START ))
      echo "sglang exited rc=$$RC after $${ELAPSED}s (ladder $$LID rung $$RUNG $$NAME)" >&2
      status exited "rc=$$RC after $${ELAPSED}s"
      if [ "$$STOPPING" = 0 ] && [ "$$HAVE_WINNER" = 0 ] && [ ! -s "$$WINNER" ] && [ "$$RUNG" -lt "$$LAST" ] && [ "$$(cat "$$STATE" 2>/dev/null)" != "$$((RUNG+1))" ]; then
        echo "$$(date -u +%FT%TZ) rung $$RUNG $$NAME exited rc=$$RC after $${ELAPSED}s; moving on" | tee -a "$$LADDER_LOG"
        echo $$((RUNG+1)) > "$$STATE"
      fi
      kill "$$MONITOR_PID" "$$HEARTBEAT_PID" 2>/dev/null
      sleep 5
      exit "$$RC"
    - 'sglang'
    - '--model-path'
    - '/data/model'
    - '--served-model-name'
    - 'adverserial/cyberseek'
    - '--host'
    - '0.0.0.0'
    - '--port'
    - '30000'
    - '--trust-remote-code'
    - '--tensor-parallel-size'
    - '8'
    - '--expert-parallel-size'
    - '1'
    - '--data-parallel-size'
    - '1'
    - '--attention-backend'
    - 'dsv4'
    - '--moe-runner-backend'
    - 'marlin'
    - '--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay'
    - '--speculative-algorithm'
    - 'DSPARK'
    - '--speculative-dspark-block-size'
    - '5'
    - '--chunked-prefill-size'
    - '4096'
    - '--prefill-decode-interval'
    - '16'
    - '--swa-prefix-tails'
    - '1024'
    - '--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode'
    - '64'
    - '--max-running-requests'
    - '32'
    - '--mem-fraction-static'
    - '0.8'
    - '--context-length'
    - '1048576'
    - '--reasoning-parser'
    - 'auto'
    - '--tool-call-parser'
    - 'auto'
    - '--enable-cache-report'
    - '--watchdog-timeout'
    - '3600'
    environment:
      NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: all
      NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES: compute,utility
      SGLANG_DSV41_REASONING_EFFORT: high
      SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE: '900'
      LADDER_ID: '2026-11-24p'
      LADDER_BUDGET_S: '3600'
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: '1'
      DO_NOT_TRACK: '1'
    depends_on:
      inference-auth-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      native-manifest-check:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    networks:
      inference: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    user: 0:0
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    cap_add:
    - SYS_NICE
    - SETUID
    - SETGID
    - CHOWN
    - DAC_OVERRIDE
    - FOWNER
    - KILL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    pids_limit: 16384
    shm_size: 32g
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:size=32g,mode=1777
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
      core:
        soft: 0
        hard: 0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
          - capabilities:
            - gpu
            driver: nvidia
            count: 8
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cyberseek-v41-native-data
      target: /data
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: sglang-cache-state
      target: /run/sglang-cache
      read_only: false
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: inference-handoff
      target: /run/handoff
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: inference-status
      target: /run/inference-status
      read_only: false
      volume: {}
  inference-auth-init:
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:91ee972ab751fb7180bc71c175865e36b091686600dca783d52b2511399810b3
    entrypoint:
    - python3
    - -B
    - -c
    command:
    - |
      import os, secrets
      path = '/handoff/upstream-token'
      tmp = path + '.tmp'
      fd = os.open(tmp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o400)
      with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
          f.write(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))
          f.flush()
          os.fsync(f.fileno())
      os.chown(tmp, 0, 65532)
      os.chmod(tmp, 0o440)
      os.replace(tmp, path)
      os.chmod('/handoff', 0o755)
      os.chown('/status', 0, 0)
      os.chmod('/status', 0o755)
      print('inference-auth-init: fresh proxy-to-inference token generated inside the VM')
    network_mode: none
    restart: 'no'
    read_only: true
    user: 0:0
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    cap_add:
    - CHOWN
    - FOWNER
    - DAC_OVERRIDE
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    mem_limit: 256m
    pids_limit: 32
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: inference-handoff
      target: /handoff
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: inference-status
      target: /status
      volume: {}
  retire-old-proxy-state:
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:91ee972ab751fb7180bc71c175865e36b091686600dca783d52b2511399810b3
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    command:
    - |
      n=0
      while [ ! -s /new/certificates/certificate.crt ]; do
        n=$$((n+1))
        if [ "$$n" -gt 2880 ]; then echo "retire-old-proxy-state: new proxy state never appeared; leaving the old volume alone"; exit 0; fi
        sleep 30
      done
      find /old -mindepth 1 -delete
      echo "retire-old-proxy-state: old proxy state emptied; remaining entries $$(find /old -mindepth 1 | wc -l)"
    network_mode: none
    restart: 'no'
    read_only: true
    user: 0:0
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    cap_add:
    - DAC_OVERRIDE
    - DAC_READ_SEARCH
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    mem_limit: 256m
    pids_limit: 32
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: proxy-state
      target: /old
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: proxy-state-v2
      target: /new
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
  native-manifest-check:
    image: vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:91ee972ab751fb7180bc71c175865e36b091686600dca783d52b2511399810b3
    restart: 'no'
    read_only: true
    user: 65532:65532
    network_mode: none
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    mem_limit: 512m
    pids_limit: 32
    depends_on:
      model-measurer:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cyberseek-v41-native-data
      target: /native
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    - type: volume
      source: model-evidence-state
      target: /model-evidence
      read_only: true
      volume: {}
    environment:
      EXPECTED_MANIFEST_B64: 
    entrypoint:
    - python3
    - -B
    - -c
    command:
    - "import base64,json,os\nexpected=json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ['EXPECTED_MANIFEST_B64']))\nmeasured=json.load(open('/model-evidence/native-manifest.json'))\nexp={f['path']:(f['size'],f['sha256']) for f in expected['files']}\ngot={f['path']:(f['size'],f['sha256']) for f in measured.get('files',[])}\nassert len(got)==len(exp) and all(got.get(k)==v for k,v in exp.items()), 'measured model payload differs from reviewed build manifest'\nprint(json.dumps({'native_manifest_verified': True, 'files': len(exp)}), flush=True)"
networks:
  default:
    name: dstack_default
  inference:
    name: dstack_inference
    internal: true
volumes:
  gpu-evidence-state:
    name: dstack_gpu-evidence-state
  model-evidence-state:
    name: dstack_model-evidence-state
  proxy-state:
    name: dstack_proxy-state
  proxy-state-v2:
    name: dstack_proxy-state-v2
  inference-handoff:
    name: dstack_inference-handoff
  inference-status:
    name: dstack_inference-status
  cyberseek-v41-native-data: {}
  sglang-cache-state: {}
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/bash
echo "----------------------------------------------"
echo "Running Phala Cloud Pre-Launch Script v0.0.20"
echo "----------------------------------------------"
set -e

# Function: notify host

notify_host() {
    if command -v dstack-util >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        dstack-util notify-host -e "$1" -d "$2"
    else
        tdxctl notify-host -e "$1" -d "$2"
    fi
}

notify_host_hoot_info() {
    notify_host "boot.progress" "$1"
}

notify_host_hoot_error() {
    notify_host "boot.error" "$1"
}

# Function: Perform Docker cleanup
perform_cleanup() {
    echo "Pruning unused images"
    docker image prune -af
    echo "Pruning unused volumes"
    docker volume prune -f
    notify_host_hoot_info "docker cleanup completed"
}

# Function: Check Docker login status without exposing credentials
check_docker_login() {
    local registry="${1-}"

    # When registry is specified, check auth entry for that registry in Docker config
    if [[ -n "$registry" ]]; then
        local docker_config_path="${DOCKER_CONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.docker}/config.json"
        if [[ -f "$docker_config_path" ]] && grep -q "$registry" "$docker_config_path"; then
            return 0
        else
            return 1
        fi
    fi

    # Fallback check when no explicit registry is provided
    if docker info 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Username"; then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function: print the SHA256 fingerprint of every authorized key
#
# Output matches `ssh-keygen -lf` and the fingerprints GitHub and Phala Cloud
# display, so an operator can match the boot log against the account's key list.
# The guest image ships neither ssh-keygen nor a base64 applet (BusyBox has
# base32 only), so openssl does both the decode and the digest.
print_authorized_key_fingerprints() {
    local file="$1"
    if ! command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "openssl not available; skipping SSH key fingerprints"
        return 0
    fi

    # Locals start unset under bash; initialize so set -u (inherited from
    # dstack app-compose.sh source) does not trip the read loop guard.
    local key_type="" blob="" comment="" decoded_bytes="" fingerprint=""
    # `|| [[ -n "$key_type" ]]` keeps the final line when the file does not end
    # with a newline; read returns non-zero there but still fills the variables.
    while read -r key_type blob comment || [[ -n "$key_type" ]]; do
        if [[ -z "$blob" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        # openssl exits 0 on undecodable input and emits nothing, which would
        # otherwise print the SHA256 of the empty string as a real fingerprint.
        decoded_bytes=$(printf '%s' "$blob" | openssl base64 -d -A 2>/dev/null | wc -c || true)
        if [[ "$decoded_bytes" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "  $key_type <unreadable key>"
            continue
        fi
        fingerprint=$(printf '%s' "$blob" | openssl base64 -d -A 2>/dev/null | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary 2>/dev/null | openssl base64 -A 2>/dev/null | tr -d '=' || true)
        echo "  $key_type SHA256:$fingerprint"
    done < "$file"
}

# Main logic starts here
echo "Starting login process..."

# Optional env vars below use ${VAR-} / ${VAR:-} so this script stays safe when
# app-compose.sh sources it under `set -euo pipefail` without registry/SSH/root
# credentials set. Bare "$VAR" throws "unbound variable" under nounset.
DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET="${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY:-docker.io}"

# Check if Docker credentials exist
if [[ -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME-}" && -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD-}" ]]; then
    echo "Docker credentials found"
    echo "Target Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"

    # Check if already logged in
    if check_docker_login "${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY-}"; then
        echo "Already logged in to Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
    else
        echo "Logging in to Docker registry: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
        # Login without exposing password in process list
        if [[ -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY-}" ]]; then
            if ! echo "$DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin "$DSTACK_DOCKER_REGISTRY"; then
                echo "Docker login failed: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
                notify_host_hoot_error "docker login failed"
                exit 1
            fi
        elif ! echo "$DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin; then
            echo "Docker login failed: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
            notify_host_hoot_error "docker login failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "Docker login successful: $DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET"
    fi
# Check if AWS ECR credentials exist
elif [[ -n "${DSTACK_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_REGION-}" && -n "${DSTACK_AWS_ECR_REGISTRY-}" ]]; then
    echo "AWS ECR credentials found"

    # Check if AWS CLI is installed
    if [ ! -f "./aws/dist/aws" ]; then
        notify_host_hoot_info "awscli not installed, installing..."
        echo "AWS CLI not installed, installing..."
        if ! curl "https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64-2.24.14.zip" -o "awscliv2.zip"; then
            echo "AWS CLI download failed"
            notify_host_hoot_error "awscli install failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        if ! echo "6ff031a26df7daebbfa3ccddc9af1450 awscliv2.zip" | md5sum -c; then
            echo "MD5 checksum failed"
            notify_host_hoot_error "awscli install failed"
            exit 1
        fi
        unzip awscliv2.zip &> /dev/null
    else
        echo "AWS CLI is already installed: ./aws/dist/aws"
    fi

    # Set AWS credentials as environment variables
    export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$DSTACK_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
    export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$DSTACK_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
    export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION="$DSTACK_AWS_REGION"

    # Set session token if provided (for temporary credentials)
    if [[ -n "${DSTACK_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN-}" ]]; then
        echo "AWS session token found, using temporary credentials"
        export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$DSTACK_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"
    fi

    # Test AWS credentials before attempting ECR login
    echo "Testing AWS credentials..."
    if ! ./aws/dist/aws sts get-caller-identity &> /dev/null; then
        echo "AWS credentials test failed"
        # For session token credentials, this might be expected if they're expired
        # Log warning but don't fail startup
        if [[ -n "${DSTACK_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN-}" ]]; then
            echo "Warning: AWS temporary credentials may have expired, continuing startup"
            notify_host_hoot_info "AWS temporary credentials may have expired"
        else
            echo "AWS credentials test failed"
            notify_host_hoot_error "Invalid AWS credentials"
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Logging in to AWS ECR..."
        if ./aws/dist/aws ecr get-login-password --region "$DSTACK_AWS_REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$DSTACK_AWS_ECR_REGISTRY"; then
            echo "AWS ECR login successful"
            notify_host_hoot_info "AWS ECR login successful"
        else
            echo "AWS ECR login failed"
            # For session token credentials, don't fail startup if login fails
            if [[ -n "${DSTACK_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN-}" ]]; then
                echo "Warning: AWS ECR login failed with temporary credentials, continuing startup"
                notify_host_hoot_info "AWS ECR login failed with temporary credentials"
            else
                notify_host_hoot_error "AWS ECR login failed"
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
    fi
fi

perform_cleanup

#
# GHCR image pull access verification (pure HTTP, no docker daemon)
#
if [[ "$DOCKER_REGISTRY_TARGET" == "ghcr.io" && -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME-}" && -n "${DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD-}" ]]; then
    # Strip surrounding quotes from compose image refs. Two tr calls keep the
    # intent obvious inside this Python string (no quote-concatenation idiom).
    COMPOSE_IMAGES=$(grep 'image:' /dstack/docker-compose.yaml 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"' | tr -d "'" || true)
    HEADER="Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json"
    for img in $COMPOSE_IMAGES; do
        [[ "$img" != ghcr.io/* ]] && continue
        ref="${img#ghcr.io/}"
        # Digest-pinned refs (repo@sha256:...) use the digest as the manifest
        # reference; tag refs (repo:tag) use the tag, defaulting to latest.
        if [[ "$ref" == *@* ]]; then
            repo="${ref%%@*}"
            reference="${ref#*@}"
        else
            repo="${ref%%:*}"
            reference="${ref##*:}"
            [[ "$reference" == "$ref" ]] && reference="latest"
        fi
        echo "Verifying GHCR pull access: $img"
        token=$(curl -sf -u "$DSTACK_DOCKER_USERNAME:$DSTACK_DOCKER_PASSWORD" "https://ghcr.io/token?service=ghcr.io&scope=repository:${repo}:pull" | jq -r '.token // empty' || true)
        if [[ -z "${token-}" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: GHCR token exchange failed for $img"
            notify_host_hoot_error "GHCR token exchange failed: $img"
            exit 1
        fi
        http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" -H "$HEADER" "https://ghcr.io/v2/${repo}/manifests/${reference}")
        if [[ "$http_code" != "200" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: GHCR pull access denied for $img (HTTP $http_code)"
            notify_host_hoot_error "GHCR pull access denied: $img (HTTP $http_code)"
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "GHCR pull access OK: $img"
    done
fi

#
# Pull latest images from docker-compose.yaml so existing CVMs pick up new tags.
# Pull is fail-soft: short-lived tokens may expire between login and pull, but
# falling back to already-cached images is preferable to blocking boot.
#
echo "Images before pull:"
docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}} ({{.CreatedSince}})'

echo "Pulling latest images from /dstack/docker-compose.yaml..."
if docker compose -f /dstack/docker-compose.yaml pull; then
    echo "docker compose pull completed"
    notify_host_hoot_info "docker compose pull completed"
else
    echo "WARNING: docker compose pull failed; continuing with existing images"
    notify_host_hoot_info "docker compose pull failed; using existing images"
fi

echo "Images after pull:"
docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}} ({{.CreatedSince}})'

#
# Set root password.
#
echo "Setting root password.."

# Check if password files are writable
PASSWD_WRITABLE=true
if [ ! -w /etc/passwd ]; then
    echo "Warning: /etc/passwd is read-only"
    PASSWD_WRITABLE=false
fi
if [ ! -w /etc/shadow ]; then
    echo "Warning: /etc/shadow is read-only"
    PASSWD_WRITABLE=false
fi

if [ "$PASSWD_WRITABLE" = "false" ]; then
    echo "Skipping password setup due to read-only file system"
else
    # Check if chpasswd is available
    if command -v chpasswd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Using chpasswd method"

        if [ -n "${DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD-}" ]; then
            echo "Setting root password from user.."
            echo "root:$DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD" | chpasswd
            unset DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD
            echo "Root password set/updated from DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD"
        elif [ -z "$(grep '^root:' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2)" ]; then
            echo "Setting random root password.."
            # dstack guest busybox lacks head -c (FANCY_HEAD off); dd is the
            # last pipeline command, so its 0 status masks tr's SIGPIPE exit.
            DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD=$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | dd bs=1 count=32 2>/dev/null)
            echo "root:$DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD" | chpasswd
            unset DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD
            echo "Root password set (random auto-init)"
        else
            echo "Root password already set; no changes."
        fi
    else
        # No chpasswd: do not pipe into interactive passwd(1). It often reads
        # /dev/tty and fails with "password for root is unchanged" during boot.
        echo "Using passwd method"

        if [ -n "${DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD-}" ]; then
            echo "Setting root password from user.."
            if command -v passwd >/dev/null 2>&1 && passwd --help 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--stdin'; then
                echo "$DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD" | passwd --stdin root
            elif command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                # busybox passwd has no --stdin; write the SHA-512 crypt hash
                # into /etc/shadow directly instead of driving interactive passwd.
                HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD=$(openssl passwd -6 "$DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD")
                sed -i "s|^root:[^:]*:|root:${HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD}:|" /etc/shadow
                unset HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD
            else
                echo "Error: cannot set DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD non-interactively"
                echo "Need chpasswd, passwd --stdin, or openssl"
                exit 1
            fi
            unset DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD
            echo "Root password set/updated from DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD"
        elif [ -z "$(grep '^root:' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2)" ]; then
            # Never lock the account here: sshd built without PAM (dstack dev
            # images) treats a locked account as "deny all authentication",
            # which breaks public-key SSH too. Set a discarded random password
            # by writing its crypt hash into /etc/shadow directly.
            if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Setting random root password.."
                DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD=$(LC_ALL=C tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | dd bs=1 count=32 2>/dev/null)
                HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD=$(openssl passwd -6 "$DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD")
                sed -i "s|^root:[^:]*:|root:${HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD}:|" /etc/shadow
                unset DSTACK_ROOT_PASSWORD HASHED_ROOT_PASSWORD
                echo "Root password set (random auto-init)"
            else
                echo "Warning: no openssl to hash a random password; leaving root password empty"
            fi
        else
            echo "Root password already set; no changes."
        fi
    fi
fi

#
# Set SSH authorized keys
#
if mkdir -p /home/root/.ssh 2>/dev/null; then
    if [[ -n "${DSTACK_ROOT_PUBLIC_KEY-}" ]]; then
        echo "$DSTACK_ROOT_PUBLIC_KEY" > /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
        unset DSTACK_ROOT_PUBLIC_KEY
        echo "Root public key set"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DSTACK_AUTHORIZED_KEYS-}" ]]; then
        echo "$DSTACK_AUTHORIZED_KEYS" > /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
        unset DSTACK_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
        echo "Root authorized_keys set"
    fi

    if [[ -f /dstack/user_config ]] && jq empty /dstack/user_config 2>/dev/null; then
        if [[ $(jq 'has("ssh_authorized_keys")' /dstack/user_config 2>/dev/null) == "true" ]]; then
            # jq -r terminates the value with a newline; jq -j does not, which
            # both concatenated the next appended key onto the same line and
            # made line-based counting report one key fewer than the file holds.
            jq -r '.ssh_authorized_keys' /dstack/user_config >> /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
            # Drop duplicates and the blank line an empty key list produces.
            sort -u /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys > /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys.tmp
            mv /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys.tmp /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
            KEY_COUNT=$(grep -c '^[^[:space:]]' /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys || true)
            echo "Set root authorized_keys from user preferences, total $KEY_COUNT keys"
            print_authorized_key_fingerprints /home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
        fi
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: Cannot create /home/root/.ssh directory (read-only file system?)"
    echo "Skipping SSH key setup"
fi

if [[ -S /var/run/dstack.sock ]]; then
    export DSTACK_APP_ID=$(curl -s --unix-socket /var/run/dstack.sock http://dstack/Info | jq -j .app_id)
elif [[ -S /var/run/tappd.sock ]]; then
    export DSTACK_APP_ID=$(curl -s --unix-socket /var/run/tappd.sock http://dstack/prpc/Tappd.Info | jq -j .app_id)
fi
# Check if DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN is not set, try to get it from user_config or app-compose.json
# Priority: user_config > app-compose.json
if [[ -z "${DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN-}" ]]; then
    # First try to get from /dstack/user_config if it exists and is valid JSON
    if [[ -f /dstack/user_config ]] && jq empty /dstack/user_config 2>/dev/null; then
        if [[ $(jq 'has("default_gateway_domain")' /dstack/user_config 2>/dev/null) == "true" ]]; then
            export DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN=$(jq -j '.default_gateway_domain' /dstack/user_config)
        fi
    fi

    # If still not set, try to get from app-compose.json
    if [[ -z "${DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN-}" ]] && [[ -f app-compose.json ]] && [[ $(jq 'has("default_gateway_domain")' app-compose.json) == "true" ]]; then
        export DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN=$(jq -j '.default_gateway_domain' app-compose.json)
    fi
fi
if [[ -n "${DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN-}" && -n "${DSTACK_APP_ID-}" ]]; then
    export DSTACK_APP_DOMAIN=$DSTACK_APP_ID"."$DSTACK_GATEWAY_DOMAIN
fi

echo "----------------------------------------------"
echo "Script execution completed"
echo "----------------------------------------------"
